description: This file defines the TransferStats class in the GuzzleHttp namespace used for capturing and providing details about an HTTP transfer, including request, response, transfer time, and handler stats.

classes.name: TransferStats
classes.description: Represents data about an HTTP transfer, capturing request, response, transfer time, handler stats, and errors.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a TransferStats object with request, optional response, transfer time, handler error data, and handler-specific stats.

methods.name: getResponse
methods.description: Returns the response object if available.

methods.name: hasResponse
methods.description: Checks if a response was received.

methods.name: getEffectiveUri
methods.description: Returns the URI the request was sent to.

methods.name: getTransferTime
methods.description: Returns the transfer time in seconds.

methods.name: getHandlerStat
methods.description: Retrieves a specific handler statistic by name.
